summary_md: **두디 Doodi ([@doodi_dev](https://x.com/doodi_dev/status/2116745798927134768))** introduces **Massless**, an MIT tool recreating paid AI film studio features with open-weight models: design shots by camera, lens and film stock, then apply 28 camera moves to a still and export MP4, plus storyboard, voiceover, captions and image-to-3D, mostly in-browser ([ChuckGPTX/massless](https://github.com/ChuckGPTX/massless)).

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - ChuckGPTX/massless: A free cinema camera for AI shots. Shot designer + camera moves, open-weight models only. Live at massless.chucksi.com

media.description: AI-generated cinematic still of a lone figure on a dark rocky shore facing a giant glowing ring portal at sunset.
